title: CRM stage hygiene
content: Treat Companies as the unit of pipeline progression. Only advance a stage when there is durable evidence in Data/CRM/CompanyEvidence, and every automatic stage change must create a StageTransitions row with a reason.

title: CRM email sending policy
content: Any external email sent from a Unify mailbox must first create an audited OutboundActions row containing actor, mailbox, reason, recipients, subject, and body. Default to dry-run unless a task or human explicitly approves sending.

title: CRM evidence matching policy
content: Prefer deterministic evidence: participant email, company domain, known contact, calendar participants, and explicit account names in titles. Treat summary-only mentions as low-confidence review items, not automatic account links.

title: CRM document ingestion policy
content: Drive and local document ingestion starts with a manifest. Classify sensitive material before content ingestion and record what was indexed, skipped, or restricted.
